target.note: IRCC requires the CLB/NCLC level in ALL FOUR skills. A single weak skill fails the whole objective.

listening.format: Multiple choice, 4 options, audio played ONCE, progressive difficulty from A1 to C2. Everyday situations, announcements, short dialogues, radio-style extracts, then longer opinion pieces.
listening.clb7_skill: Understand main ideas and important details of clear speech on familiar and some unfamiliar topics at natural speed; follow a short discussion or radio report; infer speaker attitude.
listening.strategy: Points come from the mid-band items (A2-B2). Do not chase C1/C2 items. Train: predicting from the question stem before audio, catching numbers/dates/negation, recognising liaison and elision, spoken register (on vs nous, dropped ne).

reading.format: Multiple choice, 4 options, progressive difficulty. Signs, ads, short messages, emails, then articles and opinion columns.
reading.clb7_skill: Read moderately complex texts (news, workplace emails, informational articles), find specific information quickly, understand implied meaning and connectors.
reading.strategy: Skim question first, scan text. Master connectors (cependant, pourtant, en revanche, d'ailleurs, ainsi, néanmoins) and referents (celui-ci, ce dernier, y, en).

writing.format: Task 1 (60-120 words): short message/description to a friend or on a forum (e.g. describe an event, announce, invite). Task 2 (120-150 words): a factual account/article/blog post narrating an experience or describing a situation for a wider audience. Task 3 (120-180 words): two short opinion texts are given; write a text comparing them and giving your own argued opinion.
writing.clb7_skill: Write coherent, moderately complex texts with clear paragraphs, appropriate register, varied vocabulary and mostly correct grammar; express and justify opinions.
writing.strategy: Word counts are enforced. Task 3 is where CLB 7 is decided: intro reframing the debate, one paragraph per view, personal argued position, conclusion. Learn a bank of 15 connectors and 20 opinion structures. Always proofread for agreement (accord) and verb endings.

speaking.format: Task 1 (2 min, no prep): guided interview - introduce yourself, answer examiner's questions about you. Task 2 (5.5 min, 2 min prep): interaction - YOU ask questions to the examiner to obtain information in a given scenario (e.g. you want to join a club, rent a flat, sign up for a course). Task 3 (4.5 min, no prep): express and defend a point of view on a given topic.
speaking.clb7_skill: Communicate with reasonable fluency in a range of everyday and some abstract topics; ask well-formed questions; give and support opinions; self-correct; intelligible pronunciation.
speaking.strategy: Task 2 is unusual: practise FORMING QUESTIONS (est-ce que, inversion, quel/quelle, combien, à quelle heure, est-il possible de...). Task 3: 2-minute structured answer = position + 2 reasons with examples + concession + conclusion. Record yourself daily.

grading_rubric_0_20.note: Used by the bot to grade speaking and writing. Map: 0-5 = A1, 6-7 = A2/CLB4-5, 8-9 = B1/CLB6, 10-11 = B2/CLB7, 12-13 = CLB8, 14+ = C1.

criteria.name: task_fulfilment
criteria.desc: Did they do exactly what was asked (all parts, word count, register, audience)?

criteria.name: vocabulary
criteria.desc: Range and precision; topic-appropriate words; avoids repetition and anglicisms.

criteria.name: grammar
criteria.desc: Accuracy of verb forms, agreement, articles, prepositions, pronouns; range of structures (subjunctive, relative clauses, conditional).

criteria.name: fluency_pronunciation
criteria.desc: SPEAKING ONLY: rhythm, hesitation, intelligibility, nasal vowels, u/ou, r, liaison.

grading_rubric_0_20.clb7_threshold_descriptor: Errors present but never block understanding; some complex sentences attempted; opinion clearly justified; connectors used naturally.

themes: travail, emploi, entretien, conditions de travail
immigration, intégration, vie au Canada, bilinguisme
actualité et société (vie de quartier, bénévolat, éducation des enfants)
grammar_map_to_clb7: subjonctif après il faut que / bien que / pour que / vouloir que
pronoms COD/COI, y, en, doubles pronoms
pronoms relatifs qui/que/dont/où, ce qui/ce que
interrogation (3 formes) - crucial pour l'expression orale tâche 2
connecteurs logiques et articulateurs du discours

phase_plan_months.1-2: Foundation. Assimil French with Ease lessons 1-50 (one per day, passive wave), daily pronunciation shadowing, 20 new SRS cards/day, micro-writing (3 sentences/day), 1-minute self-introduction recorded weekly.
phase_plan_months.3-4: Assimil 51-100 + active wave (translate EN->FR of earlier lessons). Start TCF-format listening/reading sets weekly. Writing task 1 twice a week. Speaking task 1 & 2 drills (question formation).
phase_plan_months.5-6: Assimil finished. Move to authentic input (RFI Journal en français facile, InnerFrench). Full TCF writing tasks 1-3 weekly, speaking task 3 opinions 3x/week, grammar remediation from error log.
phase_plan_months.7-8: Mock exams weekly under time limits. Remediate weakest skill. Book the exam ~4 weeks before target date.
